verdict.rationale: Heap documents an official web install snippet and a server-side track and bulk-track API for sending backend events, and it claims cross-platform tracking. However, the evidence names no official mobile SDKs and no backend language SDKs; backend ingestion is shown only as raw HTTP endpoints. missing for 10: documented mobile SDKs (iOS/Android/React Native etc.), official backend language SDKs (e.g. Node, Python, Ruby, Java), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms

citations.quote: To get started with Heap, paste the following code snippet before your website’s closing `</head>` tag.
we try to make Heap as easy to install as possible on most platforms and frameworks
We recommend using this for events that need to exactly match your backend, such as completed order transaction info
it takes an `events` array of objects with a max of 1000 events per request.
